topic: Six shallot and roasted garlic bread slices in one warm kitchen
style: Photoreal macro food film of six thick slices cut from one baguette, all cooked and served together. Brown butter, softened shallots, roasted garlic, thyme and Gruyere. Same copper skillet, walnut board, cream counter, natural-nailed adult hands and warm side light. Realistic food geometry; no floating objects, labels or extra hands.
requestedEnding: One finished shallot and roasted garlic bread slice is lifted from the same tray and served warm with a short believable cheese stretch.

No whole unsliced loaf, unrelated rolls, gloves, faces, logos or impossible cheese stretch.

recipe.status: creative kitchen formulation; cook and taste before publishing as a tested recipe
ingredients: 1 baguette cut into six thick slices
method: Soften diced shallots in gently browned butter with thyme and stir in squeezed roasted garlic.
Spread the aromatic butter over six baguette slices and add a restrained layer of Gruyere.
Bake the slices on one tray until the edges crisp and cheese bubbles, then finish with flaky salt and serve warm.
